evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/d extends BufferedImage, stores completion callbacks, exposes a changed/completion method that marks the image ready and runs queued callbacks, and can bind itself as an ImageIcon to JButton/JLabel consumers.

When already complete, newly added callbacks are dispatched immediately through the client task helper; otherwise callbacks are queued until the image changes. Swing components are repainted asynchronously after image availability.
RuneLite net.runelite.client.util.AsyncBufferedImage extends BufferedImage with the same callback/change lifecycle and JButton/JLabel ImageIcon helpers.
Exact v308 rs/A/a caches and asynchronously fills this type from item/sprite/image sources, confirming its asynchronous image placeholder role.

proposals.note: Historical RuneLite source identity plus exact-v308 bytecode fixes AsyncBufferedImage.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/k extends Guava CharMatcher and accepts characters in 32..126, codepoint 128, and 160..255 while rejecting other characters.
RuneLite JagexPrintableCharMatcher is the same package-private CharMatcher with the identical Jagex printable character ranges.
The matcher belongs to the same exact-v308 RuneLite text utility namespace as R466 Text and supplies the character-domain filtering used by shared text normalization.

proposals.note: Historical RuneLite source identity plus exact-v308 bytecode fixes JagexPrintableCharMatcher.
